articles.title: An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS
articles.description: Getting some extra storage space on your Mac could be as easy as deleting Apple's AI features with a new open-source command line tool called RemoveMacAI. articles.title: OpenAI is sticking more ads in ChatGPT
articles.description: OpenAI's latest ad format will put images of sponsored products and services on your screen. The ads, which OpenAI will begin testing in the US later this month, will "initially" appear when you generate images with ChatGPT, according to an announcement on Monday. articles.title: TCL’s paperlike OLED phone made me more excited for the iPhone Duo

articles.description: Google has waited until the day its new Googlebook laptops hit the market to admit that Intel-based models may have issues running some Android apps.
